description:
Validate email deliverability and decide whether an address should be used for outbound sales, account signup, transactional email, CRM import, or lead qualification. Checks syntax, MX, SPF, DMARC, disposable and role accounts; returns deliverability score, risk, contextual ALLOW/REVIEW/REJECT decision, confidence and structured reasons.
USE WHEN: agent needs deliverability validation plus a context-aware send decision before using an email address.
DO NOT USE WHEN: agent requires proof that a mailbox exists or can receive mail; no SMTP mailbox probing is performed.

use_case.description: Intended sending context; when provided, the decision accounts for context-specific risk.
use_case.title: Use Case

name: email_validator_basic

confidence.description: Confidence in the decision from 0 to 100.

decision.description: Context-aware send decision for the given use case.

mx_found.description: Backward-compatible MX result; null means lookup unavailable.

risk_level.description: Risk level derived from observed signals.

title: Email Deliverability & Usage Decision
